note: Mission factors are operator or copilot Scenario inputs. They change modeled routes or modeled verdicts; none is a measurement along the route. RAD and REMS are rover-local point readings, so only their reported values are reused here (no spatial radiation or weather map exists).

rad_msv_per_day.source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343:1244797 (Curiosity RAD, sols 13-300); also in data/cards/rad.json

sep_event_msv.source: September 2017 surface SEP event, RAD absorbed dose 418 uGy in silicon (data/cards/rad.json); treated here as 0.418 mSv assuming a quality factor of 1 (Scenario).

rems_air_min_k.source: REMS daily minimum air temperature, sols 1-4995 (data/cards/rems.json; Gomez-Elvira et al. 2012, 2014)

rems_air_max_k.source: REMS daily maximum air temperature, sols 1-4995 (data/cards/rems.json)

temperature_peak_ltst_hour.source: Team choice: sinusoid between the REMS daily min and max peaking in the early afternoon; a modeled approximation, not a forecast.

factors.label: Slope cap
factors.effect: Hard limit: no route edge is steeper than this.
factors.source: Team model; 15° is the hard model ceiling (technical-approaches §3).

factors.label: Sand avoidance
factors.effect: Raises the hazard cost of low-thermal-inertia (likely sandy) ground. Used by lowest-hazard and balanced routes; fastest ignores hazard.
factors.source: THEMIS thermal inertia 100 m (Derived proxy); weight is a Scenario input.

factors.label: Time vs hazard balance
factors.effect: Weights normalized hazard against normalized time in balanced routes.

factors.label: Crew, body mass and load
factors.effect: Changes walking time and oxygen cost on every edge, which moves the turn-back point.

factors.label: Radiation dose budget
factors.effect: Modeled dose = RAD surface rate × route and stop time. Routes over the budget are flagged.
factors.source: RAD rate Observed (Hassler et al. 2014); the budget is a Scenario input. Suit and terrain shielding are not modeled.

factors.label: Solar particle event scenario
factors.effect: Adds the September 2017 event dose to the modeled EVA dose.

factors.label: Daylight window
factors.effect: Flags routes that start before sunrise or end after sunset at Gale (Mars24).
factors.source: Mars24 solar geometry; start time is a Scenario input.

factors.label: Cold limit
factors.effect: Flags routes whose modeled air temperature falls below the limit during the EVA window.
factors.source: REMS reported daily min/max (Observed, rover-local); the hourly shape is a Scenario sinusoid.

factors.label: Time at the stop
factors.effect: Adds on-site time to the dose, daylight and cold checks.

factors.label: Science goal
factors.effect: Chooses which observed stops are offered as destinations.

phase2.label: Radio-contact requirement
phase2.reason: Needs the radio-coverage (viewshed) layer, plan §9b, which is not built yet.
